immutableDecisions: Only B4-003 active; no new gate, branch, repository, Firebase, workflow, baseline overlay, data reimport or legacy release.
Use one cumulative source candidate and current owners; reuse the existing B4-003 executor, Playwright, Firebase Emulator and governance guards.
Source fix groups by causal owner, never serial micro-batches by symptom or duplicated full audits.
Distinguish SOURCE_CORRECTED, CODE_QA_PASS, EXACT_PREVIEW_TECHNICAL_PASS, AUTHENTICATED_FUNCTIONAL_PASS, PAULA_VISUAL_PASS and LIVE_PASS; no green workflow as functional certification.
Independent read-only QA and source analysis can parallelize; serialize only Control Plane/lock/branch mutations and controlled writes.
Signed-in tests require authorized existing QA identities or a supported legitimate interactive session; do not impersonate actual users or request repeated TinyFish profile setup.
No Browser direct Firestore role bypass; enforce role, country, advisor, team on server and Firestore effective rules, preserving authorized own/team/all and approved writes.
Full protected backend/frontend parity is required for Preview and LIVE before promoting one immutable certified artifact/digest.
After each exact cumulative Preview with relevant source QA, offer Paula focused visual inspection; preserve prior visual PASS unless causal regression is proven.

Prioritize C03/C04 backend/rules/parity; then startup and active-role, Inicio/KPIs, Cliente360/Polizas/Cobros parity, Ops/Leads and commercial flows; retain Frozen priority Renewals then Upsells/Leads/Ops and B4-004..B4-007.
For any build or source change, record source SHA, blobs, buildId, hosted digest, backend digest and zero-error readback; never patch accepted artifact.
Only promote after real authenticated module-role-country-viewport QA, Paula visual, live permissions/writes/integrity/rollback gates; I6 remains 50% until formal mini-gate closure.
No data cleanup, orphan deletions, August refresh, shared Firestore Rules deploy, real credential exposure or product LIVE deployment under this decision.
